statusNote: v0.1 is stopped and stays stopped. v0.2 is a separate registration; see versions. DESIGN-v0.2.md records a SECOND defect in v0.1, found while drafting v0.2 and not caught by any check: its endpoint asked whether a dissenting position was preserved, and for these conjectures no dissent is published before the refutation, so the endpoint could not have moved even with perfect ancestry data.

threshold.rule: a case is reconstructable only if >=50% of works in its era record any ancestry
threshold.setBy: precedent (KL-001 DESIGN-v0.4 direction; BL-060 negative-control separation)
threshold.disclosedWeakness: derived after the era coverages were measured; mitigations recorded in the amendment

claimAllowed: KL-016 v0.1 is unanswerable on its declared corpus. No claim about root-aware aggregation, dissent preservation, or any listed conjecture may cite this experiment.
reusableFinding: A lineage-aware method requires a literature recording lineage for a majority of its confirming works. No field measured clears 50% before roughly 1980; medicine (47.6%) and psychology (38.7%) do not clear it today.

v0.2.statusNote: New registration with a new case list and a new question. Not a revival of v0.1: v0.1's case list is not carried forward, and mertens is excluded although it passed v0.1's screen, because retaining the survivor of a screen selects on that screen's outcome.
v0.2.claimAllowed: The instrument runs on real literature and reproduces; a conjecture's citing literature is 57-87% internally derived where a matched unrelated sample is 0%; root collapse here is not an indexing artefact (zero blind roots). NOT allowed: any predictive claim, any claim about belief, any claim that roots correspond to independent observations, anything about RH.
